description.value: Surrey Farms is a family-operated farm market established in 1989, now farming over 400 acres and operating two retail locations in Surrey. The business is best known for its exceptional fresh berries—strawberries, blueberries, raspberries, and blackberries—alongside seasonal Okanagan fruit and local vegetables. The popular U-Pick fields draw visitors from across the Lower Mainland, making this a distinctive stop for cyclists seeking fresh, locally grown produce.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM phone number (604-574-1390), address (4981 King George Blvd), and website URL. Surrey Farms is a farm market selling fresh produce including berries, fruits, and vegetables, qualifying as basic groceries. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities was found in the website content; the u-pick page mentions hand-washing stations but these are specifically for food-safety compliance before picking, not general-use water taps.
concerns: OSM community tag assigns this record to 'Tsawwassen' but the business address and website consistently identify the location as Surrey, BC — possible geolocation or community-boundary assignment error in OSM.
This OSM node represents one of two Surrey Farms market locations; the second location (5180 152 Street, Surrey BC) may warrant a separate OSM record check to avoid duplication.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established seasonal farm market open for the 2026 season offering fresh local produce; a practical and distinctive resupply stop for touring cyclists on King George Boulevard.
enrichment_extras.notes: U-pick fields (strawberries, blueberries, raspberries) are available at this location seasonally, subject to field availability — cyclists should call ahead.
